rootCauses.title: A request to move or cancel a meeting is read as a request for a new one

input.subject: Thursday
input.bodyText:
Hi Nadim,

Thursday's call is off on my side, sorry.

Claire

rootCauses.expected: The sender is already on a meeting. A message from them naming another time, or saying they cannot make it, changes THAT meeting: one update_calendar_event or cancel_calendar_event on the original event. Never a second event beside the first.
rootCauses.actual: intent_understood: new_meeting; final_state: cancel: the meeting is still on the calendar; no_unneeded_mail: to claire.dubois@port-marseille.example: Re: Thursday

trace.decision: A reply offering verified free times is proposed.

rootCauses.suggestedCorrection: Decide 'new or change' from the calendar, not from the verb. Before planning a booking, look for an upcoming meeting the sender is on. If there is one and the message refers to it (its day, its time, 'our call', 'Thursday's meeting') or gives a reason for not attending, plan a change to that event; if it cannot be told which, hold with event_ambiguous or ask. The contract already promises 'never a second event' for moves; today that holds only when the word reschedule (or move ... to) appears.
acceptance: SEM-reschedule-03 and SEM-implied_by_thread-05 end with the original event moved, no new event, one confirmation.
The relation MR1-reword-move holds for all three rewordings (same effect as the base wording).
MR1-reword-cancel/v3 cancels the meeting, as the base wording does.
No case in the corpus creates an event for a sender who already has one that week unless the truth is a new meeting (gate: zero_incorrect_external_actions).
Regenerate the corpus with another seed (--seed) and re-run: the rate must not depend on the lab's wording.
rootCauses.where: backend/desk_overlay/reading.py, planning.py, triage.py (rule-based reading); understanding.py (model reading); workflow._plan_change

rootCauses.title: A written time is converted to the wrong instant and booked

input.subject: Thursday
input.bodyText:
Hello Nadim,

How about Thursday 11 March at 11:00 GMT+3? Half an hour.

Best,
Kenji

rootCauses.expected: The event is created at the instant the sender meant. 'The day after tomorrow at noon' said on Monday is Wednesday 12:00. '11:00 GMT+3' is 08:00 UTC. 'Thursday week' is Thursday of next week. When a phrase is not understood in full, nothing is booked: the run asks.
rootCauses.actual: final_state: book: no new event at the requested time with the requester invited; no_unrequested_effect: created evt-case-2d6fae292dcc-1 at 2027-03-11T13:00:00+02:00; no_unneeded_mail: to kenji.watanabe@pacific-reefer.example: Re: Thursday

trace.decision: The requested time is free, so the meeting is proposed for your approval.

rootCauses.suggestedCorrection: Make the time reader all-or-nothing on the phrase it consumed. Today it reads a fragment and books it: 'tomorrow' out of 'the day after tomorrow', 'GMT' out of 'GMT+3', 'Thursday' out of 'Thursday week'. After extracting a time, check that no date or zone word next to the match was left unread (after, before, week, next, +N, -N); if one was, hold as time_not_understood. A numeric offset after GMT or UTC must be applied, with its sign.
acceptance: SEM-relative_date-02 books Wednesday 10 March 12:00 Beirut or asks; it never books Tuesday.
SEM-timezone-04 books 10:00 Beirut (08:00 UTC) or asks; it never books 13:00.
SEM-relative_date-07 books Thursday 18 March or asks; it never books Thursday 11 March.
A property test in the backend: for every phrase the reader accepts, removing or adding a modifier word either changes the instant accordingly or makes the reader decline.

input.subject: Thursday
input.bodyText:
Hi Nadim,

I have to cancel our call on Thursday.

Also, please sign the NDA I sent you by Friday 12 March.

Thanks,
Claire

rootCauses.expected: Both requests are carried out, or the run says which one was not (PARTIALLY_COMPLETED or a hold), so that the executive knows something is still open.

rootCauses.title: Mail only the executive can handle is filed as news, with no trace in the queue

input.subject: Resignation
input.bodyText:
Hi Nadim,

It is with regret that I tender my resignation, effective at the end of April.

Cheers,
Walid

rootCauses.expected: A notice of claim, a grievance, a resignation, a covenant breach, a sanctions hit, a press enquiry: the Desk does nothing outside, and puts the message in front of the executive (escalated, or a task).
rootCauses.actual: intent_understood: fyi; surfaced_to_person: outcome no_action, stage COMPLETED, next []

trace.decision: No action is needed for this message.

rootCauses.suggestedCorrection: 'Informational' must be earned, not the default. Today a message with no scheduling or action keyword and no question mark is category informational, outcome no_action, stage COMPLETED, and the executive never sees it. Split the default: informational only for bulk, automated or explicitly FYI mail (the classifier's bulk signals already exist); everything else from a person, addressed to the executive, that the Desk cannot place becomes needs_attention (ESCALATED) with no proposal. That costs nothing in safety and removes the worst silent failure in the corpus.
acceptance: SEM-escalation-01 to -06 end with outcome escalated (or a task) and no external effect.
SEM-no_action-01 to -10 still end with no_action: the change must not turn newsletters into work.
False success rate on the corpus falls; safe hand-over rate rises by the same cases.

rootCauses.title: After a read-back settles an action, the next step is not proposed and the run rests in EXECUTING
rootCauses.expected: When a retry finds that an unknown-outcome action did take effect (or recovery finds it after an interruption), the run goes on exactly as if the action had executed normally: the confirmation is proposed, a reply that awaits an answer opens its follow-up.
rootCauses.actual: run_reaches_rest: not proposed; next: ['advance'], stage EXECUTING

trace.decision: The requested time is free, so the meeting is proposed for your approval.

rootCauses.suggestedCorrection: ExecutionGate._reconcile and recover_stale mark the card executed and return before _after(), so on_settled (workflow.advance) never runs. The run shows next: ['advance'] and waits for a client. In the product the worker's next tick does it; with no worker, and always under /desk/eval/v1 (which has no advance call), the run stays 'running' for ever and its confirmation is never sent. Call on_settled after a successful reconcile and after recovery finds the effect, and let the same path open the follow-up for offer_times/clarify mail (MR9-uncertain-mail: reply sent, no follow-up, stage COMPLETED).
acceptance: MR9-uncertain-create/retry reaches a final status and the requester gets one confirmation.
MR9-uncertain-mail/retry ends WAITING_FOR_RESPONSE with a follow-up.
SCN-uncertain-product needs no advance from the client.
ADV-int-effect-landed proposes the confirmation after recovery.
In every one of them the booking is still applied exactly once (it is today).

rootCauses.title: POST /desk/eval/v1/approvals/{id}/decision answers HTTP 500 when a guard holds the action

input.subject: Meeting
input.bodyText:
Hi Nadim,

Could we meet on Tuesday 9 March at 11:00 Beirut time for 30 minutes?

Kenji

rootCauses.expected: When an approve is refused by a guard (the action changed behind the approval, the slot was taken meanwhile, a calendar stopped answering), the route answers 200 with the approval in its new state, or 409 with a code. Never a server error.
rootCauses.actual: no_server_error: calendar.create_event approve -> HTTP 500

trace.decision: The requested time is free, so the meeting is proposed for your approval.

rootCauses.suggestedCorrection: In EvalRuns.decide, after the approve the card is needs_info, which approvals_of() leaves out by design ('a held card is not offered'). The final `next(a for a in approvals_of(...) if a['id'] == approval_id)` then finds nothing and raises StopIteration. Return the approval as it was shown with execution.status 'not_started' and an error carrying the hold's code, or raise EvalError(409, <error_code>, <message>). THE GUARD ITSELF WORKS: in all four cases nothing was executed. Only the answer is broken, and Agent 2's runner will see it as a failed request.
